//: Where the fleet monitor is allowed to file issues. Copy to
~/kinerary-deploy/issue-target.json and fill in. Real values never live in
this repo — same rule as fleet-stacks.json.
The token is a FINE-GRAINED personal access token, scoped to this one
repository, with exactly one permission: Issues -> Read and write. It is
deliberately not the gh CLI's login: that one can push to everything you
own, and this agent reads messages typed by travellers.
Repository access -> Only select repositories -> <this repo>
Permissions -> Repository -> Issues -> Read and write
//maxPerHour: A ceiling, not a target. The monitor runs on a cron; if it ever files this
many in an hour something is looping, and the tool refuses rather than
flooding the tracker. Raise it only when you have seen the rate be real.
